steps.title: Lock out the pump
steps.instruction: Switch the isolator on the control panel to OFF and apply your lockout tag.
steps.safety_warning: Verify zero energy: press START and confirm the pump does not move.

steps.title: Let it cool
steps.instruction: Wait until the bearing housing reads below 50 °C on the overlay.
steps.safety_warning: The housing can exceed 90 °C. Wear heat-resistant gloves.

steps.title: Remove the coupling guard
steps.instruction: Undo the four M8 bolts and lift the guard off the motor shaft.

steps.title: Pull the old bearing
steps.instruction: Fit the puller to the highlighted bearing and extract it evenly.

steps.title: Fit the new bearing and restart
steps.instruction: Heat-mount the new 6308-2RS bearing, refit the guard to 25 Nm, remove the lockout and run for 2 minutes.
steps.safety_warning: Keep hands clear of the coupling during the test run.
